entities.summary: Alexander Igorevich Khokhlachev is a Russian professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing for Salavat Yulaev Ufa in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Boston Bruins, 40th overall, in the 2011 NHL Entry Draft.
